title: Prompt/Response Lifecycle Policy Wizard and Evidence Timestamping
creator: Maya Lopez
description: Provide a guided authoring experience for customers to define TTLs and lifecycle rules at prompt- and response-granularity, plus a deterministic evidence timestamping and export mechanism for audits. The wizard should generate machine-readable rules that map to runtime enforcement (prefix retention, KV cache expiry, full request logs) and an 'evidence assembly' job that bundles signed, timestamped artifacts for a given retention window.
scope: Deliver a web-based 'Policy Wizard' in Console that creates per-route or per-prompt lifecycle rules, a backend translation layer producing policy artifacts for enforcement by Serving runtime, and an evidence timestamping/export job that produces verifiable bundles (SHA256 manifest, signed metadata).
out_of_scope: Full legal packaging for all jurisdictions (we will provide hooks for legal teams), per-customer KMS integration for signing (will be separate feature), region-specific cross-account transfer tooling.
success_metrics: Customers can author and apply rules to 90% of common prompt patterns within 3 clicks
Audit export bundles include verifiable manifest and timestamp for 100% of exported items
Reduce manual retention-related support tickets by 60% in first quarter after launch
acceptance_criteria: Wizard generates valid policy artifact that runtime accepts and enforces (automated test)
Evidence export job produces bundle with manifest (SHA256), signature, and index of anonymized records
Console UI shows per-route effective TTL and preview of items that would be exported/archived
notes: Trade-off: We will default to sampled evidence exports for high-throughput routes to bound bundle size; customers can opt into full exports
Decision: Use detached ECDSA signatures from a signer service rather than each tenant's KMS in v1
Consideration: Need standard schema for prompt/response anonymization to enable evidence bundles without exposing PII
